items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1960-11-18
items.q: Alvin Francis' wife was playing trumpet

ctx.x: And then I guess Dick I forgot. I don't hear those other interviews and we get so many of them sometime I don't know.

Yeah, she gave them good interviews because she remember all them old times and remember the names and everything so good. That's good. Because her son told me that it surprised him. She remember like Edna used to play piano, Edna Francis, Alvin Francis' wife was playing trumpet, the one called Cuckoo, I never didn't know he was right, and Big Ike was playing trombone, Big Ike was on Clairvon, he's not playing anymore.
No we missed that talk to him I've been talking about. Robinson.
